description:
Implement the profile-driven selector dispatching among mathematically equivalent batch-encoding algorithm families, preserving at least one scalar reference encoder.

## Background

The dispatch mechanism is required; the concrete family set (polynomial remainder, precomputed linear recurrences, matrix-based kernels) follows the survey's workload-selection contract rather than being mandated up front. The selector composes with, and is distinct from, the SIMD feature-dispatch seam.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A dispatch seam selects among registered encoding algorithm families per profile, with the scalar reference always available and selected results bit-identical across families.
- [hard] REQ-02: At least two families are registered, chosen per the workload-selection contract, with differential tests proving equivalence on the predeclared corpus rows.
title: Profile-driven dispatch among equivalent batch-encoding algorithms
